# pi-model-sync

> omp (oh my pi) / upstream pi extension: routes subagent models by the spawning session's current model — omp-native subagents plus pi-subagent's `subagent` tool. Profiles can be grouped into named presets (one active per config layer). Zero dependencies; the hosts load the TypeScript sources directly. Managed via the `/model-sync` command.

## Install (pick the user's host)

- omp: `omp plugin install npm:@sencha930511/pi-model-sync`
- upstream pi: `pi install npm:@sencha930511/pi-model-sync`
- git, tag-pinned (either host): `omp plugin install git:github.com/SenCha930511/pi-model-sync@v0.4.0` / `pi install git:github.com/SenCha930511/pi-model-sync@v0.4.0`
- omp marketplace: `omp plugin marketplace add SenCha930511/omp-marketplace`, then `omp plugin install pi-model-sync@sencha930511`

Verify after installing: start the host and run `/model-sync list` — it prints the active config layer, the active preset, and that preset's profiles.

## Minimal config

Global `~/.omp/agent/pi-model-sync.json` (or `~/.pi/agent/pi-model-sync.json` when the `~/.omp` file is absent), project `<repo>/.omp/pi-model-sync.json`; `PI_MODEL_SYNC_CONFIG` overrides the path.

```json
{
  "activePreset": "default",
  "presets": {
    "default": [
      { "main": "provider/main-model", "subagents": { "explore": "provider/child-model", "*": "provider/default" } }
    ]
  }
}
```

`activePreset` picks the preset whose profile list is in effect for that layer; a missing or dangling name routes nothing (fail closed, no fallback). Legacy `{ "profiles": [...] }` files still work as a virtual `default` preset, and the first successful `preset create`/`preset copy` converts them. `main` matches the spawning session's model (`provider/id`, bare id, or `*` glob); per-agent selector via exact key then `*` default; first matching profile in file order wins. An agent key with no `*` default is not intercepted. An explicit per-call `model` in a pi-subagent call is never overwritten.

## Commands

- `/model-sync [list]`, `/model-sync show`, `/model-sync add <main> <model>`, `/model-sync set <main> <agent> <model>`, `/model-sync remove <main> [agent]`
- `/model-sync preset list`, `/model-sync preset create <name>`, `/model-sync preset copy <source> <name>`, `/model-sync preset use <name>`, `/model-sync preset remove <name>`
- Writes target the global file; add `--project` to write the project file. `add`/`set`/`remove` edit only the active preset; `preset remove` refuses the active preset.
